periodLabel: 2026 season (UAE Team ADQ to 31 July, UAE Team L'IMAD from 1 August)

source.name: Cyclingnews - UAE Team ADQ get new name for Tour de France Femmes and beyond (Matilda Price)
source.quote: Polish champion Dominika Włodarczyk wears the new L'IMAD-branded jersey
source.note: Team will become UAE Team L'IMAD from August 1, for the Tour de France Femmes and beyond. The article's team-supplied photo (https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XsitVR4NeLFF9LwfGXucxn.jpg) shows 'UAE TEAM / L'IMAD' across the chest, L'IMAD under NMDC on both sleeves and L'IMAD on the thigh of the shorts; the team's squad photo at the same event (https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QXGA3WyDebfiqp4Yu9ihfd.jpg) shows the same on the standard jersey.

source.name: UAE Team L'IMAD - sponsor page: NMDC (undated page, read October 2026)
source.quote: Both UAE Team ADQ and NMDC Group are dedicated to achieving significant milestones
source.note: Main sponsor. The team-supplied kit photos (https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XsitVR4NeLFF9LwfGXucxn.jpg, https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QXGA3WyDebfiqp4Yu9ihfd.jpg) show the NMDC GROUP logo on the right chest beside L'IMAD and above L'IMAD on both sleeves.

source.name: UAE Team L'IMAD - sponsor page: IHC (undated page, read October 2026)
source.quote: IHC is an international holding company that pursues high growth opportunities and advancement by investing in innovation
source.note: Main sponsor. The team's squad photo in the 2026 kit (https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QXGA3WyDebfiqp4Yu9ihfd.jpg) shows IHC on the right chest, below NMDC GROUP and Analog, and running down the right side of the jersey.

source.name: UAE Team L'IMAD - sponsor page: Analog (undated page, read October 2026)
source.quote: Through this partnership, Analog becomes the Official Technology Sponsor of UAE Team ADQ
source.note: Page written under the team's earlier name, UAE Team ADQ. Main sponsor. The team's kit photos (https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XsitVR4NeLFF9LwfGXucxn.jpg, https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QXGA3WyDebfiqp4Yu9ihfd.jpg) show Analog across both shoulders and on the right side of the jersey.

source.name: UAE Team L'IMAD - sponsor page: MyWhoosh (undated page, read October 2026)
source.quote: MyWhoosh is an indoor cycling app that provides a fun, and social experience
source.note: Listed by the team as a main sponsor. Not visible in the team's front-facing kit photos; on the men's UAE Team Emirates XRG 2026 kit it is on the back shoulders, but no back view of the women's jersey was verifiable.

source.quote: Colnago Ernesto & C. S.r.l., known as Colnago, is a manufacturer of high-end road-racing bicycles
source.note: Listed by the team as a main sponsor. The team's kit photos (https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XsitVR4NeLFF9LwfGXucxn.jpg, https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QXGA3WyDebfiqp4Yu9ihfd.jpg) show the Colnago clover at the thigh of the shorts and beside the collar on the chest.

source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. The team's kit photos (https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XsitVR4NeLFF9LwfGXucxn.jpg, https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QXGA3WyDebfiqp4Yu9ihfd.jpg) show the PISSEI mark on the chest and on the hip of the shorts. No on-page quote: the sponsors page shows the Pissei logo image without text.

summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam kit by Pissei, rebranded from UAE Team ADQ to UAE Team L'IMAD on 1 August 2026. 'UAE TEAM / L'IMAD' fills the chest, with NMDC GROUP on the right beside it; IHC and Analog stack below NMDC on the right; Analog runs across both shoulders; NMDC GROUP over L'IMAD on both sleeves; the shorts carry L'IMAD on the thigh and the Colnago clover at the hem; small Colnago clover and PISSEI marks sit by the collar, and PISSEI is on the hip of the shorts. MyWhoosh is listed by the team as a main sponsor but is not visible in the front-facing kit photos (on the men's kit it sits on the back shoulders). 'UAE' is the country's name in the team name. Not marked complete: only front-facing, team-supplied photos were verifiable; the back of the jersey and the pre-August ADQ-branded version are not documented here.
